A duty with nobody named keeps the hospi.en: A duty with nobody named keeps the hospital role (ward staff ask, the pharmacy gives). The hospital administrator always may.

A ward's store is an inventory warehouse.ar: مستودع الجناح هو مستودع في المخزون (المخزون › المستودعات). المستلزمات تأتي عادةً من المستودع الرئيسي والأدوية من الصيدلية: أنشئ وحدتين تشتركان في مستودع الجناح.
A ward's store is an inventory warehouse.en: A ward's store is an inventory warehouse (Inventory › Warehouses). Supplies usually come from the main store and medicines from the pharmacy: make two units sharing the ward's store.
A ward's store is an inventory warehouse.fr: Le magasin d'un service est un entrepôt de stock (Stock › Entrepôts). Les fournitures viennent du magasin central et les médicaments de la pharmacie : créez deux unités partageant le magasin du service.
